messages.content: Find out about traffic laws in Texas.

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas (as of 2024)** | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on freeways, 35 mph on expressways, 25 mph on city streets.
• School zones: 20 mph (or 15 mph if posted). | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• Children under 5 must be in a rear‑seat child safety seat. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Lower BAC limits for commercial drivers (0.04%) and drivers under 21 (0.02%). | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and yield at yield signs.
• At uncontrolled intersections, give way to vehicles on the right. | | **Headlights** | • Must be used from sunset to sunrise, during rain, fog, or low visibility. | | **Toll Roads** | • Texas has both toll and non‑toll roads; toll roads require electronic toll tags (e‑Tag) or pay‑by‑plate. | | **School Bus** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus stops to pick up or drop off children. | | **Lane Discipline** | • Keep left lane unless passing.
• Use turn lanes for left turns. | | **Parking** | • No parking within 20 ft of a fire hydrant.
• No parking on sidewalks. | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Registration renewal required annually.
• Vehicle inspections required for certain vehicles (e.g., trucks, taxis). | | **Insurance** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 bodily injury per person, $60,000 per accident, $25,000 property damage. | For detailed statutes, consult the Texas Transportation Code or the Texas Department of Motor Vehicles website.
message.reasoning: The user wants information about traffic laws in Texas. We can provide general info. But we might also use the lawsuit_search function? The user didn't ask about lawsuits. They just want traffic laws. So we can answer directly. No function call needed.
